children: Edge AI semiconductor firm's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 13% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Non-GAAP net income for Q2 increased from a year ago
Company reported record edge AI revenue, with growth in Auto and IoT markets
Ambarella expects Q3 revenue between $115 mln and $124 mln
Company sees Q3 non-GAAP gross margin between 59.0% and 60.0%
Ambarella says strategic initiatives are expanding its market reach and serviceable market forecast
EDGE AI GROWTH - Co said record edge AI revenue reflected balanced sequential growth in Auto and IoT markets, with strong growth from 5nm CV75 and CV72 AI SoCs
NEW PRODUCTS AND PARTNERSHIPS - Co cited progress on strategic priorities, including launch of X7 AI Accelerator and new agreements with Macnica and CapGemini, as supporting market expansion
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 6 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the semiconductors peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ambarella, Inc. is $98.00, about 46% above its September 2 closing price of $67.14
The stock recently traded at 72 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 82 three months ago
